content.rendered:
SoZo HAIR Salon Tips

In keeping our clients up to date, we felt at least letting you know what “pixelated hair color” is, would be interesting. Though it’s not for everyone, it is eye catching and creative.

Starting in 2014 the hair fashion industry has seen some radical and interesting changes in color placement and techniques.  Ombre was the first new look to take us by storm.  With its intentional outgrown highlighted look, it was made popular by the stars. Next we were stricken by pastels and smokey greys splashing the pages of fashion magazines in 2015.

Well 2016 is not even here yet, and these trends are being called a thing of the past.  So what’s got heads literally turning these days?  Pixelated hair.  Yes, that’s right, it looks just like it sounds, tiny squares painted onto the hair with lightener, and then toned with varying colors to create the look of pixels. This can be done in a soft look with colors that complement the natural hair, or with bright neons.

This look is achieved with a technique called xpresionpixel placement.  A quarter inch horizontal section of hair is divided into three small, see through, horizontal sub sections.  Underneath this section, a foil is placed with the desired pixelated pattern drawn on it in sharpie.  The foil is secured to the underlying hair using pin curl clips.  The first sub section is taken and laid over the foil.

Using a small brush, lightener is carefully painted onto the hair in the pattern drawn on the foil.  This sub section is covered with plastic film when complete, and the next sub section is dropped down directly on top of the plastic.  In this section, lightener is slightly offset of the placement from section one.  It is also covered with plastic and the final sub section is dropped.  In this section,  place your lightener opposite the original pattern, creating a checkered appearance.  The hair is lightened to the desired level, then shampooed and blown dry.  After this initial application the creative nature of your pixels is totally up to you and your designer.  They are then toned with a neutral color to add a bit of dimension,  or use fun neons or pastels to give it some edge.

Pixelated hair designs work best on short, straight, or very structured styles that have minimal movement.  The most common place to experiment with this new technique is in the fringe area so that it can easily be trimmed away once it is no longer desired.

While I may not recommend trying this at home, I do think it’s a fun and interesting new way to express artistry and personality through hair design.

About:

SoZo Salon Tips is a blog about beauty salon tips, tricks and hints.  SoZo HAIR by Bajon Salon & Spa serves the greater Cincinnati area. We are located in Olde West Chester at the corner of Cincinnati-Dayton and West Chester Rds. We’re just a short drive from Mason Oh and Fairfield Oh….a big city hair salon without the big drive and big traffic.

content.rendered:
SoZo HAIR Salon Tips

Spray tan is a quick and healthier alternative to fighting those winter blues.  Everyone looks and feels better with a bit of color, whether it’s a subtle glow or a golden sun kissed tan.  Spray tan is a simple yet effective way to feel energized after a cold winter or anytime, especially for those who have a hard time actually tanning.

Before getting your spray on, here are some things to keep in mind;

-Spray tan usually lasts about a week and a half.  Of course this may vary from person to person but consistent moisturizing does help prolong the tan.

-Shower and exfoliate before receiving your tan.  Use a body scrub or body brush to slough away any dry or flaky skin so the spray will adhere to fresh, clean skin in an even manner, and hold longer.

-Apply lotion every day.  Keeping tanned skin hydrated is the best way to prolong the color, because it won’t dry out and begin to flake or be as susceptible to rubbing off.

-Pat dry after showering.  Rubbing vigorously with a towel or wash cloth can act as an exfoliant and rub the tan off prematurely.

-Wearing nail polish, even just a clear coat will protect the finger nails from staining.  The tan spray will wipe off of nail polish, but will absorb into a natural nail, causing discoloration.

-If wearing a bathing suit while being spray tanned, wear an old suit or one that is dark in color.  The spray can stain a light colored suit.  Many choose to have “no tan lines” and go in the buff, while some prefer proof of their tan and like the tan lines.

-Wear loose fitting, and dark colored clothing to your appointment. This will keep your tan from being rubbed off while continuing to dry, and clothes won’t be stained.

content.rendered:
SoZo HAIR Salon Tips

Are you bored with your hair color? Do you need a change?
So many clients continue with the same color year after year.  Is it time to make a change?  Don’t be afraid, there are many ways to update your haircolor and still feel like you.  The slightest change can make a difference and show off your cut.
To help with the winter weather blues and look forward to warmer weather, why not add some fun to your color?  You can make the smallest change or go for a bolder look.  If you have ‘all over’ or solid color and want to add some contrast, have your hair designer place foils, baliage or ombre to add some lightness around your face.  You can add a toner with them to be sure your hi-lites compliment the over-all tone of your hair and skin.
Caramel and red tones are all the rage and can really enhance your hair cut. It will show off more movement and shine and when the sun hits these tones, they really pop.  Even the smallest change in hair color is fun, exciting and can be an introduction for the person who is wanting a change, but not quite daring yet.
On blondes you can go a little lighter or darker with your enhancements to create some contrast.  Sometimes we tend to look solid blonde after foiling the same shade repeatedly, changing up the tones or depth with several colors can also show off a great cut.
Add subtle foils or go a little chunky with them to make a bolder statement.  If adding contrast is not what you’re looking for, simply change your existing shade by going a little lighter or darker, you can also change the overall tone of your color, this will brighten up your color and add amazing shine.
If you need a change and your not sure what to do…..pick out pictures of colors that appeal to you and consult your hair designer!  Get ready for that vacation or summer event with a new you!!!!
About:
SoZo Salon Tips is a blog about beauty salon tips, tricks and hints.  SoZo HAIR by Bajon Salon & Spa serves the greater Cincinnati area. We are located in Olde West Chester at the corner of Cincinnati-Dayton and West Chester Rds. We’re just a short drive from Mason Oh and Fairfield Oh….a big city hair salon without the big drive and big traffic.
Color tips by Michelle B. at SoZo HAIR.  Visit Michelle  Tues. through Sat. at 9069 Cincinnat-Dayton Rd. West Chester, Oh. 45069  513-874-9999

title.rendered: 5 Things That Enhance Salon Visits For Guys

content.rendered:
SoZo HAIR Salon Tips

 

Let’s face it,  in the grand scheme of all things “salon and spa”, men have gotten the short end of the stick for centuries. While salons and barber shops that cater to men have been in existence, and have recently been gaining popularity,  a trip to the salon has most often been dubbed a “girl thing.”

Well I’m here to tell you that this is no longer the truth! Currently,  men enjoy a trip to the salon as much, or even MORE,  than most female clients.  Men also have the tendency to be very loyal to their stylist,  staying with the same person for years.  So the question then becomes,  what can we be doing to not only enhance the salon experience for our male clients, but also to retain new male clients and have them refer friends?  Here are 5 things we are focusing on for our male clients.


1. We offer specials for men as well as women and have a large male clientele, so know you’re not alone!

2. An outstanding scalp and neck massage.  Let’s be real, we all know men like a scalp and neck massage that they won’t forget! We use a tea tree shampoo and conditioner for that soothing aromatherapy effect, and apply firm pressure to the scalp and neck as we massage.  A great scalp massage with a shampoo and condition should last about 7-10 minutes.


3. A hot towel after shampooing.  With dim lights and soft music during the shampoo, followed by a hot towel, relaxation is hard to deny.

4. Scalp exfoliating treatments are invigorating and they clear the scalp of build up and dry skin which inhibit healthy growth and thickness.  Men do enjoy treating themselves to this service not only because it feels great, but for the benefits of unclogged pores etc.

5. Services are done in a timely manner.  If time is a concern, we respect that and focus on getting our clients on their way without delay.  But, if there’s no hurry, relax and enjoy your visit.

As this industry continues to progress, so does the demand for new and exciting services, most recently geared toward men. So men, here is our ode to you, we hope your stylist reads this and applies these suggestions to your next salon visit. We are here 6 days a week to pamper you at Sozo HAIR by Bajon Salon,  come visit us anytime for a little lovingkindness for you and for your hair!

About:

SoZo Salon Tips is a blog about beauty salon tips, tricks and hints.  SoZo HAIR by Bajon Salon & Spa serves the greater Cincinnati area. We are located in Olde West Chester at the corner of Cincinnati-Dayton and West Chester Rds. We’re just a short drive from Mason Oh and Fairfield Oh….a big city hair salon without the big drive and big traffic.

 

 

 

 

Written by Chelsea with SoZo HAIR by Bajon Salon.  Visit Chelsea M,W,TH,F,S – 513- 874-9999

content.rendered:
SoZo HAIR Salon Tips

The 2015 hottest trends for styling hair are in!  Try some of these looks to mix it up this year.  From the runway to the red carpet and in everyday looks these are realistic options to stay on trend and avoid boredom with your hair no matter what length you wear.

Boho Waves- Care free, barely there waves.  Free spirited with bohemian style.

Long Tails-Ponytails range from high and sleek to low and loose, and practically falling out.

Braids and Twists-  Twisted rope braids, messy classic braids and braids that lead to ponytails.

Big Buns-  Buns shaped in soft hearts, even bows.  Japanese style knots, and BIG, full, classic buns!

Just Add Water (or gel)- For an “out of the water look.” Slick and shiny hair, whether up or down is a hot trend for spring.

Bombshell Blowouts-  Big sleek blowouts and bouncy curls.   Setting hair on lots of rollers or roller brushes.

Last but not least, Mixed Materials- accessories, flowers, jewels, head bands!  Add some fun to any look.

With so many fun ideas, 2015 can be your best hair year yet!  Stay tuned for more hair tips on SoZo HAIR’s Facebook page and at SoZoHAIR.net

ABOUT:

SoZo Salon Tips is a blog about beauty salon tips, tricks and hints.  SoZo HAIR by Bajon Salon & Spa serves the greater Cincinnati area. We are located in Olde West Chester at the corner of Cincinnati Dayton Rd and West Chester Rd. We’re just a short drive from Mason Oh and Fairfield Oh….a big city hair salon without the big drive and big traffic.

Styling tips by Mandi at SoZo HAIR 9069 Cincinnati Dayton Rd. West Chester, Ohio 513-874-9999.  Visit Mandi Tues. through Sat. for expert hair styling and design including hair color and hair extensions.

content.rendered:
SoZo HAIR Salon Tips

 

One of the season’s hottest new trends is soft pastel hair color, many are flocking to this hair color choice for spring.  If you like your look to be fresh and lively yet have that certain allure to turn heads, give pastel hair color a try.  Pastels can enhance the beauty of your complexion and a pastel can be chosen for anyone, yes, even you guys.

Learn about the attraction of the pastel hair color trend and see whether any of these options suit you, or your style.  There are many shades and ways of using them, these soft colors can be low key but add flair and sophistication to any style.  When choosing to wear pastel hair color, deciding on placement can vary from an ombre look, pieces/strands peeking around the face or having the entire head pastel.  Some even go for many colors and a spectacular rainbow look.

The popular subtle shades are; Silver, Lavender, Rose (pink), Mint Green, Copper, Gold, Teal, Blue and Aqua.

As we see more of these shades, placed well, it tends to grow on people who at first think it’s a bit crazy.  Hair trends are continuously changing and we strive to keep you up to date on the latest.  Stay tuned for more as the spring trends morph into summer trends!

ABOUT:

SoZo Salon Tips is a blog about beauty salon tips, tricks and hints.  SoZo HAIR by Bajon Salon & Spa serves the greater Cincinnati area. We are located in Olde West Chester at the corner of Cincinnati-Dayton and West Chester Rds. We’re just a short drive from Mason Oh and Fairfield Oh….a big city hair salon without the big drive and big traffic.

Shelly V. with SoZo HAIR by Bajon Salon has a wealth of hair color knowledge and experience.  Visit Shelly at 9069 Cincinnati-Dayton Rd. West Chester, Ohio.  Call 874-9999 or log on to SoZoHAIR.net

content.rendered:
SoZo HAIR Salon Tips

Your Hair is a Fashion Statement

Hair color has become such an art.  It’s a great way to individualize and express ones self, add to ones fashion statement and conquer “hair boredom.”

Top designers are more creative than ever and love to have fun with their clients hair color.  Mixing it up, (no pun intended) is exciting for stylists and clients!  Whether a subtle, noticeable or drastic change, hair color is at the forefront of the fashion world and the options are almost endless.

Consultation is Key to Getting the Color, Cut and Style You Want

A consultation with your stylist to unveil options for your hair color is a great starting point for future consideration of what will work for you.  Keeping an open mind will usually, at the very least, give us something to think about.

Hair color creativity has come such a long way and so has hair color technology!  Being able to keep colored hair healthy is a wonderful thing and top professional grade hair color manufacturers are “all over” the technology to make this possible.  This is a great thing for both hair color clients and hair colorists/stylists.

New Hair Color Techniques

Some of the newer hair color techniques, such as ombre, sombre, rombre and baliage can be natural looking or very trendy/avant-garde but the best part is that it’s also often low maintenance, i.e. doesn’t require stringent touch ups.  The creativity of a focused and up to date hair designer is inspiring and it’s fun to experience when they have their juices flowing. Even if a subtle change is made to start, it spices thing up and gets us used to some change.  There most likely will be looks we just want to admire on others but finding something that suits “you” can be a great experience.

Remember, we wear our hair everyday, so an investment in a professional hair color, style and at home care (using professional, salon quality products like SoZo Heavenly Hair Care) is more valuable than an outfit that may be worn once a week or less.  Have fun with it and enjoy your crowning glory!

Have a HaPpY HaIr DaY!

ABOUT SoZo HAIR:

SoZo Salon Tips is a blog about beauty salon tips, tricks and hints.  SoZo HAIR by Bajon Salon & Spa serves the greater Cincinnati area. We are located in Olde West Chester at the corner of Cincinnati-Dayton and West Chester Rds. We’re just a short drive from Mason Oh and Fairfield Oh….a big city hair salon without the big drive and big traffic.

Karen Welch has 30 years of experience in the Hair Fashion Industry and is considered an expert in hair design and hair color.

SoZo HAIR by Bajon Salon & Spa is located at 9069 Cincinnati-Dayton Rd, Olde West Chester, OH 45069. Call 513- 874-9999 for appointment.
